summary: The release rule table for an entity's vtable[0](1): eleven unregistration steps across the GameEntity level 009287B0, the entity root 00925780 and the observer endpoint 00695760. 00927050 is not a teardown site but the spawn-descriptor apply at virtual slot +9Ch, and its +5Dh write is the mission Lua deadMeat property applied at creation. No vtable[ECh] handler reaches 00926E80 (163 handlers over 564 vtables, 81 scanned raw because Ghidra has no function for them), so the drain's re-entrancy hazard is not reachable through the hit path. 006DE3F0 only drops a marker and may unregister the unit/marker-manager observer pair, which makes 008DFE50 a clear rather than a refresh. Ghidra was read-only.

routines.coverage: partial: the kind-1 property-bag branch 00927089-0092720A read as its key list only; the kind-3 Lua branch 0092721B-00927386 complete
routines.evidence: 00927080 tests entity[+C0h]; 00927086 CMP ECX,1 and 0092721B CMP ECX,3 on *(entity[+C0h]+4h). Virtual slot +9Ch in 31 vtables, the slot 00928A00 occupies in 10 (local/slot_of.py); 00928A00 also calls it at 00928A1E. 009272E3 reads the Lua field deadMeat (key string at 00D190D8) and 009272EF/009272F3 set entity+5Dh and entity+70h; 00927295 reads active (00CE4A08) and 0092729F calls 00922F80 BSP_SceneNode_Disable when it is clear.

routines.name: STL_list_InsertRange_009269b0
routines.abi: __thiscall(list* this, iterator where at +8h/+0Ch, iterator first at +10h/+14h, iterator last at +18h/+1Ch), RET 1Ch at 00926AC1
routines.evidence: The insert loop is 009269F0-00926A54 and exits by JZ 00926AB1 at 00926A01. No jump in the body targets 00926A56; that address is reached only through the frame handler pushed at 009269B5, so the tail is the catch(...) rollback: it erases one node per consumed source element and ends at 00926AAC PUSH 0; PUSH 0; CALL 00BF6885 (rethrow).

routines.name: BSP_Objective_ClearUnitMarkersAndEmpty
routines.evidence: The walk collects every live unit and hands each to 008DFC00, and its per-unit marker call 006DE3F0 only drops (006DE418-006DE426 destroys the slot object and nulls the slot; no insert anywhere in 006DE3F0-006DE4BA). Both callers are the completed and failed transitions, so the routine empties the objective and clears its markers; the existing RefreshUnitMarkers name is replaced.

routines.name: BSP_MarkerManager_DropUnitMarker
routines.abi: __thiscall(MarkerManager* this, const NativeString* name, Entity* unit), RET 8 at 006DE4B8
routines.evidence: 006DE000 is an operator[]-shaped red-black-tree lookup on the map at this+14h keyed by the unit pointer (_Isnil at node+1Dh, key at node+0Ch); 006DBD40 resolves the name to a slot. 006DE418: if *slot then slot->vtable[0](1) at 006DE424 and *slot = 0 at 006DE426. The loop 006DE447-006DE491 returns at 006DE47E on the first remaining entry whose +14h is set; otherwise 006DE49F tests the observer pair and 006DE4AC unregisters it.

routines.name: STL_SetPtr_Insert_008de6a0
routines.abi: __thiscall(_Tree* this, pair<iterator,bool>* result, const void** key), RET 8 at 008DE71D and 008DE756
routines.evidence: Node layout _Left +0h, _Parent +4h, _Right +8h, key +0Ch (4 bytes), _Isnil +11h. 008DE74E writes the bool 0 on the found path and 008DE715 writes 1 after 008DE010 inserts. At the 008DF3D7 call site this = EBX+18h with EBX the ObjectiveSet (008DF2D2 stores ECX at E-18h, 008DF330 reloads it), the key is the address of the unit argument and the pair is discarded.

routines.name: BSP_Objective_EraseUnitEntries
routines.evidence: Walks the std::list at this+20h (_Myhead +24h, _Mysize +28h). 008DC423 CMP dword ptr [ECX],EDX compares record+0h against the unit. 008DC439 frees the record and 008DC441 nulls node+8h; 008DC460-008DC468 unlink; 008DC46B frees the node and 008DC473 ADD dword ptr [EBP+8],-1 decrements _Mysize. It continues past the first match. 008DC43E-008DC447 and 008DC470-008DC476 were read from the PE bytes because the listing omits the runs after the free calls.

routines.name: BSP_Observer_IsPairRegistered
routines.abi: __fastcall(ECX = subject endpoint, EDX = callback owner) -> bool, RET at 00694B69 and 00694B8C, no stack arguments
routines.evidence: 00694B0F BSP_ObserverLockOwner_Get, 00694B28 EnterCriticalSection through [00CE2218] with the recursion count kept by hand at cs+18h, 00694B3E 006949D0 BSP_Observer_FindPair with ECX and EDX unchanged, then leave through [00CE2210] and return AL = 1 or 0. Argument order confirmed at both call sites: 006DE49F ECX = unit, EDX = marker manager; 008DF338 ECX = EBP the unit, EDX = EBX the ObjectiveSet.

routines.name: BSP_ScriptEntity_Destruct
routines.evidence: Installs 00D11138/00D11120/00D11118/00D11114, fetches the Lua globals at [00E188A8]+1A0Ch (00928976), reads thisTable (00CE7494, 0092898C) and calls 00B67350 with &entity[+178h], the entity's own name, as the key before tail-calling 009287B0. Its only caller is the scalar deleting destructor 00888ED0, the script-entity branch of BSP_LuaBinding_CreateScript 00898750, so the unit path never reaches it.

routines.name: BSP_ObserverEndpoint_Destruct
routines.evidence: Installs 00CECCC8 at +0h, the most-base vtable of the 00925CE0 column. Takes the observer lock twice through BSP_ObserverLockOwner_Get, reads endpoint[+8h], releases the inner lock, calls 006953C0 when the list is non-empty, releases the outer lock and frees endpoint[+4h]. 006953C0 walks the global edge table at 00E198E4 under the same lock. BSP_Recon_DestroySlot 00805240 calls the same routine.

routines.name: BSP_World_UnlinkFromUpdateChain
routines.evidence: Link pair at node+34h/+38h, head fields first/last/count at this+0h/+4h/+8h. 00903F39-00903F44 skips the work only when both links are null AND the count is at most 1. 00903F7B decrements the count. The head is *(entity[+30h]+4h), the chain 00904BF0 BSP_World_UpdateEntities walks.

routines.name: BSP_Entity_UnlinkFromSiblingChain
routines.evidence: The same body as 00903F30 over the +40h/+44h link pair. Called with ECX = parent+48h when the entity has a parent and ECX = *(entity[+30h]+8h), the world root list, when it does not. 00922FD0 walks the same chain through +48h and +44h.

routines.name: BSP_UnitList_Remove
routines.evidence: Walks this[+4h] through +4h for the node whose +8h is the entity and calls 004837D0 on it. The membership flag is the counter at entity+B8h that 009245A0 maintains: BSP_UnitList_PushBack on the 0 to non-zero edge and 004845A0 on the non-zero to 0 edge.

The three producers 00819A20, 0084BAD0 and 0084BC60 have 19 ancestors, all projectile and explosion ticks.
